subject: Hosted API follow-up: quick volume snapshot & budget target
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@novacorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-09T15:02:00-08:00
Subject: Hosted API follow-up: quick volume snapshot & budget target

Hi Sarah — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and a couple of asks so we can size a clean POC/MA: 

Call recap:
- Use case: in-product assistant for customer support flows + searchable chat summaries.
- Important constraints: sub-200ms median token latency target for UI calls; occasional short bursts from marketing campaigns.
- Success metric for POC: parity on latency and cost vs current vendor for the same quality threshold.

What we need from you (ballpark numbers are fine):
1) Expected steady-state monthly token volume (1M units) — rough band (e.g., 1–10M / 10–50M / 50M+).
2) Peak TPS profile: expected sustained peak (TPS) and short burst behavior (peak TPS and typical burst duration).
3) Any hard budget target expressed as $ per 1M tokens (if you have a target unit econ you want us to aim for).
4) Timeline: when would you like to kick off a POC and how long should it run?

Attachments: I attached a one-page mutual-action-plan to speed approvals (mutual-action-plan.xlsx). If you can also share a CSV export of current monthly tokens (or a rough sample), that helps us model price bands quickly.

I looped Marissa and Karthik on this thread so they can scope a POC offer once we have the numbers. Thanks — short replies welcome.

— Priyom
Priyom Das | Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
From: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@novacorp.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@novacorp.com>
Date: 2026-12-09T17:08:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API follow-up: quick volume snapshot & budget target

Thanks Priyom — good to meet today. Numbers below (all ballpark):

1) Monthly token volume: ~15,000,000 tokens/month (we expect this to grow ~20% QoQ if POC goes well).
2) Peak TPS: steady sustained peak ~85 TPS during business hours; marketing-driven bursts up to ~200 TPS for ~30–45s. We can tolerate short throttles but prefer graceful degradation.
3) Target unit econ: aiming for ~$18 per 1M tokens (we currently pay ~25/1M and are looking to reduce).
4) Timeline: would like to kick off a POC in early Jan (week of Jan 10) for 6–8 weeks.

I've attached a small export of our current usage to help modeling (novacorp-usage-export.csv). Tom will help with SSO/SCIM requirements if we move forward.

— Sarah
Sarah Liu | Head of Product Integrations | NovaCorp
sarah.liu@novacorp.com
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-09T17:45:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Hosted API follow-up: quick volume snapshot & budget target

Marissa / Karthik — forwarding Sarah's numbers. Quick internal thoughts and proposed commercial approach: 

- NovaCorp: ~15M/mo; peak 85 TPS (sustained) w/ bursts to 200 TPS for ~30–45s. Target $18/1M.
- Proposal idea: 3-month canary POC with a 10M token commit at a promotional $15/1M + backstop overage at $22/1M. After POC, convert to month-to-month hosted pricing or move to Dedicated if they want capacity guarantees.
- Operational asks: we should suggest prefix/KV caching guidance (reduce token burn), and ask product to add a simple latency SLO trace for the POC.

Attached a one-pager on our pricing bands to share internally (redwood-pricing-bands.pdf). If you approve the pricing tie-lines, I can send a short commercial proposal + SOW to Sarah and Tom.

Questions for you: 
1) Approve the $15/1M short-term promotional rate for the 3-month POC?
2) Any concerns about handling 200 TPS bursts on hosted — do we need to advise them to plan burst queueing or suggest Dedicated trials earlier?

— Priyom
